name: Kamarion Johnson
strengths: Johnson clicks and closes from slot/safety looks, triggering downhill on underneath throws.
Johnson mirrors with fluid hips in man and stays in phase through receiver breaks.
Johnson shows natural ball production -- timing on breaks and tracking to contest/create takeaways.
Johnson tackles with leverage and wrap in run support, playing physical for a 185-pound frame.
weaknesses: Johnson still needs to prove he can hold outside CB vs length receivers if asked to leave the nickel/star role.
comparison: Johnson comps to Minkah Fitzpatrick -- 6-0 versatile DB who wins with instincts, hip fluidity, and ball skills from multiple alignments (size-matched to Johnson's 6-0 / 185 ATH mold).
projection: Johnson projects as develop into the secondary as a Star/nickel, earn early special-teams and package snaps, then compete for a starting nickel/field role -- starter upside as a multi-alignment ball hawk.
schemeFit: Johnson fits White's Star/nickel who can match slots and rotate to safety/field looks.
